description: Principal Financial Group, Inc. is a leader in global financial services offering businesses, individuals and institutional clients a wide range of financial products and services, including retirement, asset management and workplace benefits and protection solutions through its diverse family of financial services companies, and it had $1,814.6 billion in assets under administration, including $781.0 billion in assets under management as of December 31, 2025. Its global asset management businesses serve a broad range of institutional, retirement, high net worth and retail investors worldwide, with focused investment teams providing diverse, long-term investment capabilities including equity, fixed income, real estate and other alternative investments as well as fund offerings, and its international asset management and accumulation businesses focus on the opportunities created as aging populations around the world drive increased demand for retirement accumulation, retirement asset management and retirement income management solutions.
